name: COLORS
overview:
Naomitsu Nakamura, a freelance video editor, who's both shy and sincere, spends his days together with his close friends Anna Fujisaki (who's a freelance writer/screenwriter) and videographer Yoshiaki Saiki with whom he shares an office.

His only source of anxiety in his life recently has been his client, director Igarashi, whom he has never met in person before. His arrogant behavior over e-mail correspondence drives him insane.

Then comes Naomitsu's 30th birthday. Pushed by his friend's Anna's words and emboldened by alcohol, he signs up for a gay dating app and arranges to meet a guy named Sota with whom he matches immediately. The same evening, the two meet and share a kiss, Naomitsu's first-ever kiss. However, the nerves and alcohol cause him to vomit on the spot, and the evening comes to a disastrous close.

The next day, the director Igarashi finally comes to the office to introduce himself in person. However... the man who appears before Naomitsu is none other than Sota.
